name: engine_cylinder_count
title: Engine cylinder count and operating parameters at rated power
summary: Four-stroke H2 engine sized from bore, stroke, mean piston speed and rated shaft power: the non-integer cylinder count is rounded up with the mean effective pressure corrected. Submerged operation at part load with an O2 + recirculated-H2O oxidiser, stoichiometric combustion and volumetric efficiency from the mixture molar mass.

origin.course: Machines et combustion industrielle (ULiège), TP2 exercise 3
